figurative_meaning_en: swearing an oath by God's name to assert ignorance or innocence
similar_in_english: Cross my heart and hope to die
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি নামে বলছি, আমার কোনো দোষ নেই।
নাম ধরে শপথ নিয়ে বললাম, সত্যি কথা।
example_sentences_in_english: I swear by God's name, I know nothing about it.
Taking an oath by name, I assure you it's true.
note: The idiom text appears garbled; interpreted as invoking 'নাম' (divine name) for oaths, common in Bengali speech for emphasis.
